title: The ferry drowning of the trumpet player
summary: A foggy Saturday night, a skiff overturned and the trumpet player Dejon drowned; the instruments and his cousin the trombonist were saved.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians
